Mohamed Aziz Missaoui

Computer Systems Engineering student

I earned a mathematics baccalaureate at Pioneer High School of Jendouba and now study at South Mediterranean University. Coursework in microelectronic circuits and embedded systems has helped me put that foundation to work on projects like a battery-backed hydroponics controller.

I enjoy 3D printing prototypes and testing circuits at the bench. Working across hardware and firmware has made me curious about what happens inside the processor itself. My goal is to design electrical systems and contribute to the development of CPU architectures.

Hydroponics Monitoring

Seven sensors on one board

I designed and bench-tested seven sensor interfaces for our hydroponics controller. For analog probes like pH, I scaled and filtered the voltage before the ESP32-S3 sampled it.

Explore the controller

HomeGuard

Motion control on the STM32

I wrote the C firmware that turns ultrasonic echoes into distance readings and drives the rover’s stepper motors. The project includes bare-metal and FreeRTOS implementations.

Explore the rover

DropLock

A five-person smart locker project

I led our DropLock team and worked on the booking API, operator dashboard, and tablet workflow. In our live demo, we followed a parcel from online booking to pickup.

Explore the locker
